messages:
mira_cs: quick heads-up — OpalCrest onboarding health looks wobbly. p95 generation latency on hosted is ~720ms and token spend is ~28% above forecast. renewal is on watch, so i want a low-risk optimization proposal. thoughts?

aj_devx: saw the metrics earlier. likely causes: long context windows + no prefix/KV caching for their most common flows. low-effort wins: int8 quantization + swap to a compact model (redwood-compact-7b) for non-critical routes. also consider routing heavy traffic to a Dedicated pool during peak.

sam_se: @mira_cs can we get their 20 canonical prompts uploaded into an eval run? want to measure quality delta before proposing to product. target: <1% change in key scoring metrics.

leo_sre: Dedicated routing looks promising — from similar customers, moving matching traffic to Dedicated GPUs cut tail latency to ~200–250ms. cost/commit tradeoff needed though. we can prototype with burst capacity if they don’t want a full commit.

mira_cs: plan suggestion: 1) run eval on their 20 prompts vs current prod model 2) if pass, launch a 5% canary routing to redwood-compact-7b with int8 profile + automatic fallback to prod model on quality regressions 3) enable prefix caching on routes flagged as repeated prompts 4) schedule a 30m enablement call with their eng team to sync.

aj_devx: cheap config snippet for the canary routing (example):
```
route: /generate/opalcrest
canary: 5%
models:
  - name: redwood-compact-7b
    quant: int8
    fallback: prod-redwood-13b
routing_policy:
  - prefer: dedicated_if_latency_above_300ms
  - fallback_to: prod-redwood-13b
```

sam_se: once we have eval results i can craft the prompt set for in-prod monitoring (per-prompt regression alerts + delta scoring). we should capture their acceptance criteria in the enablement call.

leo_sre: ops note — if we enable prefix caching, we'll need to whitelist the routes to avoid cache poisoning. also we should set a short TTL initially (e.g., 2h) and monitor hit rate.

ops-bot: scheduled: canary deployment window request created for 1745559600 — ops-approved pending "preflight-check".

mira_cs: perfect. i'll book the 30m session for tomorrow and include renewal owner. tagging tasks: @aj_devx prepare canary config, @sam_se run eval and set monitoring, @leo_sre validate dedicated burst sizing.

aj_devx: on it. will share a short runbook for rollback and expected cost delta (<8% projected) before canary.

sam_se: will kick off eval now, updating thread with results. :rocket: 

leo_sre: adding a note — if quality delta >1% on the eval, we can still try hybrid routing: compact for non-critical assistant turns, prod for everything else. lower risk.

mira_cs: thanks team — goal is a proactive, low-friction path to lower latency and lower unit cost without jeopardizing renewal. i'll capture the customer's feedback in the enablement call and loop back here.
